mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% over three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls and a decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% each within a month signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% each in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both PAYEMS and UNRATE met the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts by more than 5% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST decreased by more than 5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index by more than 0.3% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, which erodes real earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP and decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% and 0.3% respectively over a quarter signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 0.5% & UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both GDPC1 and UNRATE met the trigger conditions.
